about: Cancel an expired tenancy contract for a property that has been vacated in Dubai.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Cancel a tenancy contract. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: At a trustee centre the applicant must be the tenant or hold an official power of attorney
Through the app the tenant and landlord must both be individuals with up-to-date owner data
documents: Original Unified Tenancy Contract, unless it is still active, in which case it must be shown
Power of attorney if a representative applies
Letter from the owner asking for cancellation if the contract is still active
fees: Free through the app or the Ejari system
AED 40 plus VAT for the service partner at a trustee centre
channels: a Real Estate Service Trustees Centre
